critical_separation: Evidence adjudication performed by this pipeline is NOT human curation. The two are stored in disjoint field sets and a test asserts the human fields stay null. An automated adjudication may never be recorded as 'manual review completed'.

evidence_resolved_statuses.definition: sources support including the record in production aggregation
evidence_resolved_statuses.requires: a positive statement from a source of the appropriate priority tier
an explicit basis; never mere absence of evidence

evidence_resolved_statuses.definition: the record is real but carries no usable coordinate observation
evidence_resolved_statuses.requires: source annotation present, coordinate observation impossible

evidence_resolved_statuses.definition: a ligand is annotated but absent from the deposited coordinates
evidence_resolved_statuses.requires: source annotation plus verified absence from the coordinate file

evidence_resolved_statuses.definition: available sources do not settle the question
evidence_resolved_statuses.requires: nothing; this is the honest default

evidence_resolved_statuses.definition: sources disagree and none has priority
evidence_resolved_statuses.requires: two or more sources with incompatible statements

evidence_resolved_statuses.definition: the issue does not apply to this record

performance_metric_rule: Accuracy, sensitivity and specificity may be computed ONLY against an independent human-reviewed gold subset. With no such subset, no performance rate is produced.
